name: Adaiah
overview: The name Adaiah appears in Scripture associated with various individuals who played distinct roles within Israel’s history and worship. Adaiah is identified as the grandfather of King Josiah through his daughter Jedidah, highlighting his connection to the Davidic royal line (2 Kings 22:1). Others bearing the name served in religious capacities, including as priests and musicians, reflecting their involvement in temple service (1 Chronicles 6:41; 1 Chronicles 9:12). Additionally, Adaiah is noted among the Benjamites and as a father to Maaseiah, indicating the name’s presence across tribal and familial lines in Israel (Ezra 10:29; 2 Chronicles 23:1). These references collectively emphasize Adaiah’s varied but significant roles within God’s covenant community.
